description: Create posts from a video the user provides. Pass EXACTLY ONE of mediaId (from finalize_media_upload or import_media_from_url — preferred for files you uploaded) or videoUrl (a public link). The video becomes the post's media and AI writes captions based on the topic. Runs asynchronously — the user is notified when posts are ready. Posts are always saved as DRAFTS: nothing is published or scheduled. To go live, call schedule_post or publish_post once the user confirms. Output: { success, taskId, groupId, count, finalStatus: 'draft', videoUrl, posts: [{ id, status: 'generating', index }] } — poll get_task_status with taskId.

count.description: Number of caption variants/posts to generate (default 1; only more when the user asks for more)

mediaId.description: mediaId of a video stored with finalize_media_upload or import_media_from_url. Omit when you pass videoUrl.

topic.description: What the video/post is about (required for the caption)

videoUrl.description: Public HTTP/HTTPS URL of the video. Omit when you pass mediaId.

name: create_post_from_video
title: Create Post From Video
